gh "issue" "create" "-R" "cv/pit" "--title" "ci: upgrade pi-action to v2.5.4 and remove the NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT workaround" "--body" "pi-action [v2.5.4](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases/tag/v2.5.4) fixes the problem that #384 works around (cv/pi-action#85, fixed in cv/pi-action#88). pi-action now installs `extensions` with `npm install --allow-git=root`, so npm 12 installs git specs such as `github:cv/pit#ref` without extra configuration.

## To do
In `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml`:
- Change `cv/pi-action@753f11099794ad93567438fdd1b94f1fd2f79d59 # v2.5.2` to the v2.5.4 commit: `cv/pi-action@27723deedf4b41e99924171402c657c8d4e9ff69 # v2.5.4`.
- Remove the `env: NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all` block (and its comment) from the "Run pi-action" step.

## Notes
- With `NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT` set, pi-action uses that value and doesn't add `--allow-git`, so the workaround still works until you remove it.
- `root` allows only the specs listed in `extensions`, not git dependencies of those packages. If pit's install needs transitive git dependencies, keep `NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT: all`.
- v2.5.3 also moves the composite action to `actions/setup-node@v7`. See the [v2.5.3 release](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases/tag/v2.5.3)."
